summary: Novo Nordisk filed a Form 6-K disclosing a share repurchase programme under the EU Safe Harbour Rules. The company initiated a tranche on 6 May 2026 to repurchase up to DKK 11.2 billion in B shares through 1 February 2027, as part of a larger DKK 15 billion programme running from 4 February 2026. Daily transactions show repurchases at average prices around DKK 290-302. The board has approved the programme; no advisor is named. Treasury shares now total 33.2 million, or 0.7% of share capital. This open-market buyback returns capital directly to shareholders; watch for execution pace and potential tender offers.
